g.text: ./deploy-all.sh <uat|prod> [apply] — runs every module's deploy script in dependency order
phases run top → bottom; each is idempotent, so re-running is a safe no-op on no drift
PREREQUISITE FOR PHASE 5 — public HTTPS must be live
DNS for beta.leocdp.com -> the load balancer, and Caddy's Let's Encrypt cert issued. (api falls back to SSO_LOGIN=false until sso-realm runs — safe to run early, re-run after.)
psql runs ON the 'server' box (bastion) against the PRIVATE managed DB —
so Phase 1 'server' must exist before the schema load.
Caddy terminates TLS for beta.leocdp.com (auto Let's Encrypt)
sso-realm writes KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET -> sso/.env, which deploy-api.sh reads to turn SSO on.
